design_goal.primary: Exercise a target-response objective while preserving fixed residues.
design_goal.formal_success_definition: Match two declared synthetic goal residues without changing frozen or target residues.

positive_signals: Frozen binder residues and target chain remain unchanged.
failure_signals: A chain is missing or has the wrong length.

provisional_assumptions: The sequence objective is synthetic and carries no biological meaning; ESMFold and Protenix are used only to teach the model-evidence flow.
